invite.title: Welcome to Skin Fix
invite.subtitle: Enter your invite code to get started.
invite.invalid: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.

welcome.tagline: Scan your face, answer 5 quick questions, and get the 1–2 products that fix your main focus.

tips.title: For the best scan
tips.light: Face a window with natural light

camera.noFace: Fit your face in the oval
camera.center: Center your face in the oval
camera.permissionBody: Skin Fix needs your camera to scan your face. The photo stays on your phone until you start the analysis.
camera.noFaceOnPhoto: We couldn't find your face clearly in that photo. Try again facing the camera.
camera.manualOnly: Line up your face in the oval, then tap the button

check.title: Does this look clear?
check.tooDark: This photo looks too dark. Face a window and try again.
check.tooBright: This photo looks too bright. Step out of direct sun and try again.

q1.title: A few hours after washing your face, it feels…
q1.shiny_tzone: Shiny on forehead and nose only

q2.title: When you try a new product, your skin…
q2.often: Often stings, itches or goes red

q5.title: Is any of this true right now?
q5.reason: So we don't suggest anything that isn't safe for you.

budget.title: Your max budget per product
budget.hint: We'll only show products at or under this price.

helper.intro: No worries, let's figure it out.
helper.testResultPrompt: Where did the tissue pick up oil?
helper.error: The helper couldn't load. You can leave this as not sure.
helper.tissue1: Wash with a gentle cleanser and pat dry.
helper.tissue2: Wait 1 hour with nothing on your skin.
helper.tissue3: Press a clean tissue on your forehead, nose and each cheek.
helper.tissue4: See where the tissue picks up oil.

results.title: Your Skin Map
results.tapZone: Tap an area to see what we noticed.
results.recheckBody: Do the tissue test, then scan again with your result to get a surer answer.
results.patchTest: Patch test first: try a small amount behind your ear or on your jaw for 2 days.
results.pricesNote: Prices from noon at time of search.
results.noListings: We couldn't find enough good matches under your budget.
results.disclaimer: This is general skincare guidance, not medical advice.
results.dermTitle: This is worth showing a dermatologist
results.dermNoProducts: We won't suggest products for this until a doctor has had a look.
results.englishFallback: Some text is shown in English.
results.noProducts: No products for now: focus on gentle basics and check in with your doctor.
results.adjusted: We removed a suggestion that didn't fit your answers.

retake.title: Let's try that again
retake.too_dark: The photo is too dark to see your skin.
retake.blurry: The photo is a bit blurry.
retake.makeup_or_filter: Makeup or a filter is hiding your skin.
retake.face_not_clear: We couldn't see your face clearly.
retake.other: We couldn't read your skin from this photo.

errors.network: No internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: That took too long. Please try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: You've reached today's scan limit. Try again tomorrow.
errors.unauthorized: Your invite code isn't working anymore. Check it in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.savePhotosHint: Off: only the Skin Map and results are saved on this phone.
settings.clearConfirmBody: This deletes every saved scan on this phone.

history.title: Past scans
history.empty: Your scans will show up here.
